_comment: Tier-2 for febio::damage#1. Five variants: type="damage" is not registered ('tag "material" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "type"'); deleting <elastic>, <damage> or <criterion> each gives 'Component "Material1" needs to have property "<name>" defined' with the name CHANGING to the deleted one — the fixture requires the other two names to be absent, so the discrimination is what is pinned; and flat elastic parameters give 'tag "E" (line N) : unrecognized tag'. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'elastic_damage_properties=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
